com.invoiceparserpro/capability.description: Correct the quantities, prices or other supported values on one selected saved invoice line. Financial changes can reset approval. Review and confirm the exact change first. The preview expires after five minutes. Preview only; nothing is applied until you confirm.
examples: For the saved line we selected on our fictional practice invoice, preview changing quantity to 2, unit price to 12.50, tax amount to 0 and total to 25.00. Show any approval impact and wait for my confirmation.

description: Prepare changes to one previously read invoice line. Requires confirmation; financial changes can reset approval. This returns an exact preview and a five-minute confirmation token; it does not apply the change.
name: preview_edit_invoice_line_item
title: Preview: Correct a line item
